description: This file defines a set of React components for a UI drawer, including the main Drawer component and various subcomponents like DrawerHeader, DrawerFooter, DrawerTitle, etc. It uses React's forwardRef for some components and imports primitives from a library called 'vaul'.

methods.name: Drawer
methods.description: Main drawer component that wraps DrawerPrimitive.Root and manages background scaling.

methods.name: DrawerHeader
methods.description: Component for the drawer header section, styled with grid layout.

methods.name: DrawerFooter
methods.description: Component for the drawer footer section, styled with flex layout.

methods.name: DrawerTitle
methods.description: Component for the drawer title, styled with text classes.
